description: NT Government Open Data Portal is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Northern Territory Government. The NTG Open Data Portal provides a searchable catalogue of datasets and resources released openly by Northern Territory Government agencies, including a wide range of topics and geographic regions within the Northern Territory. Users can search the portal using keywords, refine results using filters, or browse datasets by category. The NTG Open Data Portal is produced by the Northern Territory Government. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
